name: Antaeusuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in Itasuchidae, which has no clade entry in the atlas yet; placed in Notosuchia, the nearest atlas ancestor.
sum: Antaeusuchus is a peirosaurid notosuchian from the Cretaceous Kem Kem Group of Morocco.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: One occurrence in the Kem Kem beds.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Nicholl et al. 2021

images.artist: Cecily S. C. Nicholl, Eloise S. E. Hunt
images.caption: Antaeusuchus taouzensis fossil.
